messages:
maria_cs: FYI we saw ~120 accounts flip to 'onboard_stalled' after last night's automation run. many are in the 'bridgeback' cohort we migrated last month.

dev_ops: which run id? i didn't change playbook logic overnight.

maria_cs: run id bridgeback-20231210-01. logs show `playbook:bridgeback_cleanup` executed at 00:45. some canonicalization logic reassigned child contacts.

sam_data: quick root cause: contact canonicalization moved event timestamps to different contact records; our healthscorer treats that as event deletion. i can run a delta to compute impact.

sam_data: SQL i used to generate top diffs:
SELECT account_id, prev_health, new_health, prior_events, new_events FROM bridgeback_audit WHERE run='bridgeback-20231210-01' ORDER BY (prev_health-new_health) DESC LIMIT 200;

nate_prod: we should avoid treating metadata-only canonicalization as event loss. proposal: add a 'soft-preserve' mode to bridgeback playbook that keeps last_event and recent_usage if event_count_change < 2 and change_type = 'canonicalize'.

maria_cs: yes please. also we need an owner_reengage_list for accounts with renewal <= 90d. cs team will do a targeted check before we re-run.

dev_ops: i'll add the soft-preserve flag behind a feature toggle and run a small canary (ARR>25k and bridgeback tag) in dry-run. will attach delta CSV. ETA 30m.

alerts-bot: Canary job queued: bridgeback-dryrun-1772003030. Artifacts: s3://redwood-ops/bridgeback/bridgeback-dryrun-1772003030.csv

dev_ops: dry-run done: affected=58, median_health_drop=6.2, renewal_risk=7. uploaded CSV.

maria_cs: grabbing CSV. will validate the 7 renewal-risk accounts now and spin up outreach if confirmed.

sam_data: i'll PR a scorer rule to ignore event reassignments when only contact canonicalization occurred. test coverage included.

nate_prod: also adding a monitoring gate: if median_drop > 8 or renewal_risk > 5, pause automation and notify cs+product.

maria_cs: next steps: 1) dev_ops merge feature toggle + re-run canary; 2) sam_data merge scorer ignore-rule; 3) cs validate CSV and take outreach on confirmed renewal risks. thanks team :thumbsup:
